combo_label: The Launderette × Cricket × The Moon Landings

entries.clue: First human to set foot on another world, in July 1969
Chemical cleaner sold as powder, gel or a little capsule
Second flood of clean water that carries the lather away
Pair of rollers that squeezed water out in the days before spinning
Pressurised white garment with its own air supply, worn outside the craft
Second man down the ladder, who quietly took communion inside the lander first
Wrist-spinner's disguised ball, breaking the opposite way to the stock one
Runs credited for a stroke that reaches the perimeter along the ground
Small terracotta vessel at Lord's, said to hold the ashes of English cricket
Meshed practice cages where players groove their strokes before play
